Subject: Initial ask: certification calendar & questionnaire needs

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week. BluePeak is starting to map out our vendor certification windows for Q3/Q4 and we wanted to confirm Redwood's readiness posture for a few items before we lock our audit calendar. High-level asks: 

- Do you have a current ISO 27001 certification plan (target audit window / expected cert month)?
- What is the expected FedRAMP readiness posture this year (pre-assessment vs. full authorization timeline)?
- Can you share cadence for SOC 2 evidence drops and any typical sample windows?
- We also need the completed SIG/CAIQ (or a status) to feed into our vendor risk tool.

I've attached a short questionnaire (BP-Questionnaire-V1.xlsx) with the fields our compliance team will ingest. If you can indicate a rough timeline and a point person we can coordinate with, that would help.

Preferred: a 30–40 minute sync this week or early next week. Our audit partner (audit@trustassure.io) may be included later for dates.

Appreciate it—Dana

--
Dana Morris
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
BluePeak Financial

Subject: Re: Initial ask: certification calendar & questionnaire needs

Hi Dana — thanks for this and for the clear questionnaire. I looped in Kimberly (Security & Compliance) and Rachel (Audit ops) so we can respond with concrete dates and required artifacts. Quick answers up front:

- ISO 27001: We are planning an external audit in late Q3 (targeting mid-September), with internal gap remediation through July/Aug. We can provide an audited scope and certificate-of-intent by next week.
- FedRAMP: We are in a pre-assessment phase with an external assessor; realistic path to authorization would be >9 months and depends on scoping decisions. We can share a current readiness scorecard and our remediation roadmap.
- SOC 2: We run quarterly evidence windows; typical snapshot periods are end-of-quarter. For evidence packaging we can support a rolling evidence handoff 4–6 weeks before your scheduled auditor window.
- SIG/CAIQ: Kimberly will indicate status and whether we can provide an exported CAIQ today or a redacted SIG spreadsheet.

Proposed next steps:
1) Kimberly/Rachel: confirm which artifacts map to the BP questionnaire and whether we can return a CAIQ export by EOD tomorrow.
2) Dana/BluePeak: share your preferred audit windows (you mentioned Q3/Q4) and any hard blackout dates.
3) Schedule a 30-minute sync — are you available Thu 3/26 10:00am PT or Mon 3/30 11:00am PT?

I'll follow up with a one-page timeline for the next 48 hours.

Best,
Lauren
Director, Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Lauren — thanks for the fast reply. A few clarifications from our side:

- Preferred audit window: week of Sept 14–18, 2026 (we need final vendor evidence two weeks prior).
- If Redwood cannot commit to an ISO audit in that window, we would accept a documented ISO timeline plus confirmation of controls in scope.
- For FedRAMP, our vendor intake flags any provider with <12 months to authorization as a higher risk; please flag if your internal estimate is >9 months.

We attached a simple timeline (rough) and highlighted two must-haves: CAIQ export (or SIG equivalent) and SOC 2 evidence map (control -> artifact) for the last 12 months.

Also copying our assessor (audit@trustassure.io) for calibration on sample sizes and intake formats.

Thanks — Mark
